inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The manuscript names the closest comparator frameworks, states the shared producer-checker features and the P33-specific owner semantics, and bounds every originality statement to documented support.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript names the closest comparator frameworks; states the producer-checker features shared with those comparators; distinguishes the P33-specific mathematical owner semantics; and limits every originality, novelty, or priority statement to the scope supported by identified documentation.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies genuine evidence for at least one required component—closest-comparator identification, shared-feature comparison, P33-specific owner-semantics distinction, or bounded originality language—but one or more of those components is missing, materially incomplete, or not applied to every originality statement.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the text removes or weakens closest-comparator identification, shared-feature comparison, or the P33-specific owner-semantics distinction, or broadens any originality, novelty, or priority statement beyond its documented support.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis: the bounded-contribution and literature/theoretical-framework discussion, especially roadmap-proposed base blocks B0022 (replace_block) and B0037 (insert_after). Substantively equivalent evidence elsewhere in the manuscript qualifies; presence at a proposed block without satisfying the full pattern does not.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every artifact named in the reproducibility claim has a resolvable locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, and access condition, or is explicitly identified as unavailable without implying retrievability.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For every artifact named in the reproducibility claim, the manuscript supplies a resolvable locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, and access condition; alternatively, any unavailable artifact is explicitly marked unavailable and is not described in language that implies it can be retrieved.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript adds genuine locator or availability information, but at least one named artifact lacks one or more of the required locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, or access-condition fields, or an unavailable artifact remains ambiguous about retrievability.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the text removes or obscures artifact identity, locator, path, version, SHA-256, access-condition, or unavailability information, or newly implies that an unavailable or non-resolvable artifact is retrievable.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Complete standalone correction entries for both P33-S03 and P33-S16 are resolvable in references.bib; every affected manuscript use is bound to its base record and the applicable correction record; the pre-existing claim boundaries remain in force; and evidence of separate bibliography authorization covers the references.bib mutation rather than relying on the B0044 or B0107 manuscript-block permissions.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The main methods text states the field-facing evidence-synthesis procedure without role-by-role process narration, and any retained phase history is clearly separated as provenance.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The main methods text explains the field-facing evidence-synthesis procedure without role-by-role process narration, and every retained account of numbered phases or process history is clearly separated from that methods account and labeled as provenance.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: A frozen fixture set contains independently authored expected outcomes and recorded oracle provenance; a trust graph enumerates producers, adapters, checker kernels, libraries, theorem encodings, fixture-oracle authorship, and accountable implementers; every shared dependency is classified as allowed, disclosed, or disqualifying; producer decision code is absent from verifier predicate kernels; and producer, adapter, and checker build/provenance hashes are recorded.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The evidence surface identifies a frozen fixture set with independently authored expected outcomes and recorded oracle provenance; provides a trust graph enumerating producers, adapters, checker kernels, libraries, theorem encodings, fixture-oracle authorship, and accountable implementers; classifies every shared dependency as allowed, disclosed, or disqualifying; establishes that verifier predicate kernels contain no producer decision code; and records build/provenance hashes for the producer, adapter, and checker components.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The evidence surface supplies a genuine fixture, oracle-provenance, trust-graph, dependency-classification, code-separation, or build/provenance-hash control, but any required entity or relation is omitted, any shared dependency remains unclassified, independent fixture authorship or oracle provenance is incomplete, producer decision code separation is unestablished, or any required component hash is absent.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the revision removes or weakens fixture independence, oracle provenance, trust-graph coverage, shared-dependency classification, producer/verifier code separation, or component build/provenance hashes; newly permits producer decision code in verifier predicate kernels; or strengthens an independence claim while leaving those dependencies less explicit.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The schema surface defines canonical bytes, closed enums, a proof-type registry, state transitions, the digest domain, validator predicates, and fixture bytes that exercise both valid and invalid records.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The schema surface specifies canonical serialized bytes, closed enumerations, a proof-type registry, state-transition rules, the digest domain, validator predicates, and concrete fixture bytes covering both valid and invalid records.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The schema surface concretely specifies at least one required contract element, but canonical bytes, closed enums, the proof-type registry, state transitions, the digest domain, validator predicates, or either the valid-record or invalid-record fixture bytes remain absent or materially underspecified.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the schema becomes less determinate—for example by removing byte rules or fixture bytes, opening a previously bounded enumeration, weakening state transitions, leaving the digest domain or validator predicates more ambiguous, or reducing valid/invalid fixture coverage.

operationalization.partially_addressed: At least one producer contract gains genuine procedural detail, but either producer lacks any one of the exact input representation, enumeration domain, enumeration order, cutoff procedure, termination measure, coverage digest, unresolved ledger, or independently replayable population-bound check requirements.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, either producer contract loses or weakens any required input, enumeration, cutoff, termination, coverage, unresolved-accounting, or population-bound-replay element, or replaces a bounded procedure with an unbounded, heuristic, or non-replayable one.

operationalization.partially_addressed: The evidence workflow adds genuine row-level retrieval, screening, or passage information, but at least one source-use row lacks a required interface, date, query, identifier-or-unavailable-receipt, screening disposition, or exact passage/hypothesis locator, or the totals do not reconcile to both 20 sources and 48 uses.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every target-empty or control-nonempty statement is labeled as an unverified inherited assumption for architecture unless an exact separately authorized source/proof record is cited, and no arithmetic or Route conclusion follows from it.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Every statement that the target is empty or the control is nonempty follows one of the criterion's two permitted evidence branches: it is labeled an unverified inherited assumption used only for architecture, or it cites an exact source/proof record covered by separate authorization; in all cases, the manuscript draws no arithmetic conclusion and no Route conclusion from that statement or asymmetry.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript correctly labels or separately supports at least some target-empty/control-nonempty statements and preserves at least part of the inference boundary, but at least one such statement lacks both the required assumption label and an exact separately authorized source/proof record, or an arithmetic or Route implication remains.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, any target-empty/control-nonempty statement loses its unverified-assumption label or separately authorized exact source/proof support, is presented more strongly as established fact, or newly supports an arithmetic or Route conclusion.
